# dsh-free-web
Free web search for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) with **no search API and no API key**.
`dsh-free-web` registers a search provider that reads Bing's public result page over plain HTTPS, fa
lls back to its RSS view, and only then falls back to a local Chrome/Edge headless render. It powers
DSH's built-in `web_search` tool, adds a per-session **Web off / Smart / Always** toggle next to th
e composer's permission control, and adds a search panel to the left sidebar.
No browser extension is involved. DSH's UI is a web surface, so this package has two halves: a Host
half (Node) and a Client half (React components loaded by DSH itself). Chrome is only an optional he
adless renderer invoked by the Host.
中文说明
## Features
- **No search API, no key**: the provider scrapes the same public result page a browser would load.

- **Three search modes per session** in the composer toolbar:
- **Off** — `web_search` is blocked by

a Host guard; `web_fetch` stays available for links the user provides.
- **Smart** (default) — the
model decides during reasoning when to search, and may search repeatedly and follow up with `web_fet

ch`.
- **Always** — the Host runs one search automatically at the start of every user turn, injects

the results as runtime context, and the model may search again if they are insufficient.
- **Left-si

debar panel** for manual searches, with engine status and per-result links.
- **Works on Web and Des
ktop**: routes live under `/api/dsh-free-web/` and the Client half uses relative URLs, so the same c

ode works for `dsh web` and the Desktop shell's `dsh-app://` page.
- **Fail-open**: if every engine
fails, the agent tool falls back to its normal error and the turn continues.

## Requirements
- DSH **0.2.1-rc.3** or newer (developed and tested against 0.2.1-rc.3, `desktop` profile, Windows 1

1).
- Node.js 20+ on the Host (DSH bundles its own runtime).
- Optional: Google Chrome or Microsoft
Edge for the render fallback. It is auto-detected; the plugin also works with HTTP-only search.

Uninstalling the bundle removes the patch and restores the shipped defaults.
## Usage
### Composer toggle
The button sits to the right of the permission preset in the composer toolbar and shows the current
mode (`🌐 Smart web`):
| Mode | Behaviour |
| **Web off** | `web_search` calls are rejected by a Host guard; `web_fetch` remains available so th

e model can open a URL the user supplied. |
[该节后续省略]
### Sidebar panel
Click **联网搜索 / Web Search** in the left sidebar to open a manual search panel:
[该节后续省略]
## How it works
1. **Provider** — `index.js` registers a `WebSearchProvider` with id `free-web` into `ctx.web`. `ava

ilable()` is always true; `search()` runs the chain below and returns `{ sources, truncated }`.
2. *

*Search chain**
1. `https://www.bing.com/search?q=…` parsed from `li.b_algo` blocks (title, URL, sni

the same URL, using a throwaway profile under the OS temp directory.
3. **Per-agent policy** — on `a
gent/created` (and for agents that already exist when the plugin mounts) it registers, on the agent'

emPrompt.section` whose text follows the current mode;
- a `systemPrompt.context` that carries the a

utomatic results in *always* mode;
- an `agent/pre-step` listener that performs the automatic search

on the first step of each turn.
4. **Client UI** — `client.js` registers the sidebar entry, the mai
n panel (`main`, key `free-web`) and the composer toggle (`conversation.input.left`). It talks to th
e Host over `api/dsh-free-web/status`, `/search` and `/mode` with relative URLs.
## Security
- Routes accept only local callers: a missing `Origin`, `null`, the `dsh-app:` shell origin, or a lo

opback host (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `[::1]`). Other origins get `403`.
- `POST` must be `applicat
ion/json`, which is the CSRF boundary: a cross-site JSON request needs a preflight that only local o

rigins pass. Bodies are capped at 64 KiB; queries at 400 characters.
- No cookies, no browser sessio
n, no login state is read. The optional headless browser starts with a fresh temporary profile and i

s deleted afterwards.
- Search results are external, untrusted data. The built-in `web_search` tool
already labels them as untrusted; the panel does the same.
## Limitations
- Bing can change its markup, rate-limit scraping, or serve different results by region; the chain r

etries through RSS and a local browser, but relevance is Bing's.
- In **Always** mode the automatic
query is the user's message text (up to 400 characters). Long or conversational prompts may produce

broad results; the model is instructed to refine with its own search.
- The Chrome fallback is slowe

r (typically 6–15 s) and is only used when HTTP parsing fails.
- This project is not affiliated with
DeepSeek, Microsoft, or Google.
